name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime
description: Dev-time type + minimal-runtime stand-in for @mstar-harness/dsh. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub provides the consumed type surface (ClientContext, ConversationSnapshot/ContextMessageNode, session standard kit useSession/sessionId/useProjection, global kit useSessions/useWorkspaces) plus a minimal SlotsService twin and a createSnapshotStore test double. Mirrors dsh-private commit 347a99b (2026-08-07 snapshot).
